scope: Observed and documented feature areas; not an exhaustive inventory of latest additions

features.boundary: Selected runner paths read; complete tree, current revision and runtime behaviour unverified.

features.feature_area: Strict step handling and failure propagation
features.boundary: Unsupported steps and catch-all behaviour require negative tests in the selected release; no all-steps coverage claim.

features.feature_area: HTTP requests, auth, JSON/YAML and polling
features.boundary: TRACE clause in the readable snapshot is explicitly unimplemented. Presence of a handler is not success evidence.
Driver, browser and user interaction behaviour not exercised.
Cached-source aggregation concern requires fresh-checkout recheck. No throughput or scalability result.
Wiring was readable, not delivery/restart validation of a scheduled notification.

features.feature_area: Report metadata and IPFS evidence references
features.boundary: Identity, disclosure and availability are separate. No new report upload/download run.
Executing by content reference does not establish correct expectations or indefinite retention.
The guide documents /api/version; probe not executed and response not an independent build attestation.

features.feature_area: Release NFT discovery and artifact verification
features.boundary: Historical guide describes lookup and verification; current artifacts, minting and installation not tested.

features.feature_area: Distributed execution, consensus and shared payout narrative
features.boundary: No complete current implementation audit, multi-node consensus run or linked settlement evidence retrieved. Not announced as delivered.
Report accounting metadata does not establish token settlement, liquidity or earnings.

features.feature_area: Bitcoin RPC, Core Lightning and LND integrations
features.boundary: Readable overview names integrations; no live wallet, channel or invoice validation. README snapshots were inconsistent.
An evaluation topic, not a release-specific protocol or paid-execution claim; full path needs fresh review.
Protocol text read; exact current DamageBDD endpoint permissions/defaults were not established.

features.feature_area: Encrypted secrets and optional cryptographic backends
features.boundary: No deployment-wide post-quantum or non-exportable-key claim. Backend selection and key lifecycle require direct validation.
Samples differ by revision; do not copy old defaults or assume optional features remove all startup dependencies.

features.feature_area: Application wiring, interfaces and operational controls
features.boundary: No fresh dependency graph, access-control audit or recovery test.

features.feature_area: Encrypted private corpus and corpus permissions
features.boundary: Historical design decrypts scanned segments in trusted-worker memory; corpus-wide policy, not ciphertext inference or row-level isolation.
Local endpoint routing and remote allowlists do not prove every onward data flow. No live model or provider test.

features.feature_area: Lexical retrieval and selected search context
features.boundary: Deterministic lookup and retained context do not guarantee semantic relevance or correct answers.

features.feature_area: Durable indexing jobs and ingest/WAL components
features.boundary: Supervisor declarations and described recovery design are not a fresh interruption/recovery test.
Historical Wikidata filter and restore-integrity questions must be rechecked; no all-Wikipedia scale benchmark.

features.feature_area: Disk-backed indexes and bounded indexing pipelines
features.boundary: Artifact completeness, supported queries and clean-consumer portability require release-specific checks.

features.feature_area: Search evidence, hashes and proof boundaries
features.boundary: Integrity identities do not establish relevance, truth or correctness of source selection.
Artifact types differ; lineage reference is not proof of complete incremental recomputation.

features.feature_area: Index NFT preparation and mint boundary
features.boundary: Historical mint helper uses a dry call; not evidence of submitted/confirmed mint. Current status unknown.
Historical in-memory paid flag is not settlement. Do not transfer that description to latest code without recheck.
Structural relations can support investigation; no semantic proof or benchmark victory inferred.

features.feature_area: Repair preflight, candidate verification and capsules
features.boundary: A separate worktree is not a security sandbox; current tests and real repairs not run.
Dated guide reports learner absent from linked public revision and target-validation mismatch. Current resolution not known.

features.feature_area: Signed Nostr events and relay-client integration
features.boundary: Signature/authorship, relay acknowledgement and complete request/reply are separate outcomes.
Historical full-event archive has owner-controlled writes; append-only archive does not itself implement current-view search semantics.
Historical volatile pending queue can lose unsubmitted work. No current durability conclusion without fresh code.

features.feature_area: Recent search relay / NIP-50 and context integration
features.boundary: NIP-50 semantics reviewed; latest implementation, endpoint names and tests not retrieved. Article deliberately a blueprint.
Historical run retains exact release and scope; no new external-client handoff or signing run.
Secrets Manager retrieval is not an HSM operation. Current state does not prove historical deletion or access revocation.
Documented public reads; signed uploads do not make downloads confidential. No client conformance or load results.
Deleting one service claim does not wipe every claim or every remote copy; retention remains operational.

features.feature_area: erm voice intent, media, native TTS and model assistance
features.boundary: No new microphone, player, model, speaker-verification or native UI run; no voice authorisation claim.

features.feature_area: erm supervised workspace and replaceable UI
features.boundary: Application declaration is not full GTKGS/session/recovery coverage; other recent desktop additions not enumerated.
damage, ecai, erm, nosternity, vanillae and bop names/declarations do not constitute a feature audit of all applications.

features.feature_area: Org site article discovery and evidence metadata
features.boundary: This pack changes content/index only; native Org export and deployed discovery generation remain untested here.
